launch_shell:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/thuan/topic_c_ivc
source /home/thuan/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qtsd
export PYTHONPATH=src OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
python -u -c 'import json,subprocess,time,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from topic_c.manifest import sha256_file
root=Path("/home/thuan/topic_c_ivc")
path=root/"configs/controlled_retinanet_tf32off_v1_20260906.json"
frozen_config=sha256_file(path)
plan=json.loads(path.read_text())
out=root/"outputs/controlled_build"/plan["attempt"]
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
def log(text):
 print(datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),text,flush=True)
def verify():
 assert sha256_file(path)==frozen_config,"execution config changed"
 bad=[p for p,h in plan["files"].items() if not Path(p).is_file() or sha256_file(p)!=h]
 assert not bad,("frozen input changed",bad)
def ready():
 mem=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=memory.free","--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],text=True).strip().splitlines()
 rows=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name","--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],text=True).strip().splitlines()
 busy=[r for r in rows if r.strip() and Path(r.split(",",1)[1].strip()).name!="sunshine"]
 return len(mem)==1 and int(mem[0])>=12288 and not busy
try:
 log("QUEUE_START 3 builds; 27 inference/evaluation/validation bundles; no training")
 verify()
 for step in plan["steps"]:
  if step["gpu"]:
   while not ready():
    log("WAIT_GPU: requires idle compute GPU and 12288 MiB free")
    time.sleep(30)
   assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>=20*1024**3,"less than 20 GiB disk free"
   verify()
  log("START "+step["name"])
  with (out/(step["name"]+".log")).open("x") as f:
   subprocess.run(step["argv"],cwd=root,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  log("DONE "+step["name"])
 log("QUEUE_COMPLETE: 3 engines and 27 validated metric bundles; paired analysis pending")
except BaseException as e:
 log("QUEUE_FAILED "+repr(e))
 raise
'
